visual_synopsis: In a leafless winter park a man in a white knit cap sits on a green bench talking with a bearded man in a beret and an orange-and-black vest, then gets up and walks off down the paved path. He runs into a third man in a black coat and fur hat further along the path, they talk while walking, and there is a cutaway close-up of a dress shoe stepping into an orange mess on the pavement.
